end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides and corners, including rectangles and triangles. Ayaan explained that a rectangle has four sides and four corners, and used finger-counting to count. They mixed up a triangle’s shape when it was tilted, and this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, show triangles in different positions and ask Ayaan to trace and count all three sides.
